dialogues.speaker: Eunomia
dialogues.text: That's right. I'm comparing this to my previous work in external publicity relations, by the way.

dialogues.speaker: Eunomia
dialogues.text: I'll never be able to understand how some of my old colleagues thought. It's almost as if they had a waterfall in their heads that could wash all their reason away.

dialogues.speaker: Eunomia
dialogues.text: "We should construct a bust of the Chief Justice at the entrance to the Palais Mermonia!"

dialogues.speaker: Eunomia
dialogues.text: —They'd say, as if we didn't have enough people coming in from outside.
